instructor_evaluations_scores_ck.name: instructor_evaluations_scores_ck
instructor_evaluations_scores_ck.value: "instructor_evaluations"."teaching_score" between 0 and 100 and "instructor_evaluations"."punctuality_score" between 0 and 100 and ("instructor_evaluations"."student_feedback_score" is null or "instructor_evaluations"."student_feedback_score" between 0 and 100)

payments_reversal_ck.name: payments_reversal_ck
payments_reversal_ck.value: "payments"."reverses_payment_id" is null or "payments"."reversal_reason" is not null

stock_levels_qty_ck.name: stock_levels_qty_ck
stock_levels_qty_ck.value: "stock_levels"."min_qty" >= 0 and ("stock_levels"."max_qty" is null or "stock_levels"."max_qty" >= "stock_levels"."min_qty") and ("stock_levels"."reorder_qty" is null or "stock_levels"."reorder_qty" > 0)

stock_movements_sign_ck.name: stock_movements_sign_ck
stock_movements_sign_ck.value: ("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('opening','receipt','transfer_in','return_from_room') and "stock_movements"."qty_delta" > 0) or ("stock_movements"."movement_type" in ('issue','transfer_out','return_to_supplier') and "stock_movements"."qty_delta" < 0) or "stock_movements"."movement_type" = 'adjustment'

stock_movements_issue_target_ck.name: stock_movements_issue_target_ck
stock_movements_issue_target_ck.value: "stock_movements"."movement_type" <> 'issue' or "stock_movements"."issued_to_room_id" is not null or "stock_movements"."issued_to_department_id" is not null

purchase_orders_approval_ck.name: purchase_orders_approval_ck
purchase_orders_approval_ck.value: "purchase_orders"."status" not in ('approved','sent','acknowledged','partially_received','received','closed') or ("purchase_orders"."approved_by" is not null and "purchase_orders"."approved_at" is not null)

purchase_orders_source_ck.name: purchase_orders_source_ck
purchase_orders_source_ck.value: "purchase_orders"."rfq_id" is not null or "purchase_orders"."exception_id" is not null

quotation_evaluations_scores_ck.name: quotation_evaluations_scores_ck
quotation_evaluations_scores_ck.value: "quotation_evaluations"."technical_score" between 0 and 100 and "quotation_evaluations"."quality_score" between 0 and 100 and "quotation_evaluations"."commercial_score" between 0 and 100

supplier_invoices_approved_ck.name: supplier_invoices_approved_ck
supplier_invoices_approved_ck.value: "supplier_invoices"."status" not in ('approved','paid') or "supplier_invoices"."approved_by" is not null

suppliers_approved_ck.name: suppliers_approved_ck
suppliers_approved_ck.value: "suppliers"."status" <> 'approved' or ("suppliers"."vat_number" is not null and "suppliers"."approved_by" is not null)
